retention: Trace documents have no delete API and remain under native X-Ray retention (30 days). No tracing destination, encryption, standing identity or default sampling rule changed.

Deleted group control and tags are absent by GetGroup(name/ARN), GetGroups and ListTagsForResource; immediate GetServiceGraph by former group ARN still returned historical graph data, retained in cleanup observation rather than asserted absent.
instrumentation: Explicit synthetic instrumented application documents; submitted AWS metadata names are fixtures, not claims of real AWS service execution. No AWS service-generated span layout is invented.
harness_discrepancies: Python task agents share the eval kernel. A sibling rebound global paths during the filter matrix, causing requests to /GetTraceSummaries and /GetTraceGraph instead of /TraceSummaries and /TraceGraph. HTTP 200 UnknownOperationException envelope rows are invalid-route evidence, NOT query success. Valid query matrix rerun in isolated XQ namespace. The original initial summaries and graphs used correct paths. The groups-with-owned call separately used incorrect /GetGroups fallback; corrected /Groups captured subsequently.

Finalization extracts UnknownOperationException code from retained HTTP-200 envelope for invalid-route rows; the live helper initially derived Success solely from HTTP status. These rows are deliberately excluded from semantic replay. No result body was changed.
transport: result.output is JSON-decoded raw HTTP, NOT SDK-decoded. raw_response_body retains JSON spelling/null/absent fields; response headers retain request IDs. SigV4Auth signs without automatic retry; secret/session/request Authorization headers are never retained. Shared audit cleanup observations are explicitly transport=botocore-decoded, preserving separate raw_response_body when available; their SDK output is not equated with raw JSON/XML.

replay.read_phases: Rows with phase identify native convergence intervals; replay consumer must not treat bounded earlier empty/partial graph rows as converged semantics. Use final row of each poll phase, preserving ordering and fields of all observations.
replay.invalid_route_rows: capture_errors contains literal wrong-path HTTP responses and diagnosis, never ordinary semantic observations. Every intended acceptance case was repeated correctly, including GetGroups.
replay.time_binding: Trace IDs, document timestamps, query ranges, generated service/group names and owner annotations require consistent fixture bindings. Never hardcode missing/null as zero or sort histogram/source order without a contract.
replay.pagination: No successful response in this bounded ten-trace scenario returned a non-null NextToken. Malformed tokens are retained; real continuation-page ordering remains unobserved.

findings.semantics: The assembled trace has Duration 7 and ResponseTime 2. Ordinary backend has 6.5 seconds; remote front->backend edge uses caller subsegment 1.5 seconds, not callee duration. Attached independent AWS subsegment is a 5-second inferred unknown node. The client node has null summary/histograms while its edge carries root request statistics.

Root HasError/HasFault/HasThrottle reflect entry-point outcome, not OR across downstream outcomes. Throttle root has HasThrottle true and HasError false. Service()/edge() predicates expose downstream failures. Root cause arrays carry client-impacting flags, exception and remote coverage projections.

In-progress root has null Duration/ResponseTime but IsPartial false. Complete root with traced=true missing downstream also showed IsPartial false in this capture. Ordinary orphan parent produces IsPartial true, EntryPoint null, ResponseTime null, Duration 0.25. Completion and joining a downstream ordinary segment advanced Revision from 1 to 2.

TraceId membership used document start, not timestamp bits of the deliberately older trace ID. Event matched receipt/update time. Service plus service(name) discriminated segment end. Service without a service predicate returned clock trace even for adjacent non-overlapping one-second document windows; do not substitute a guessed end-time predicate for this observed fallback.

AND binds more tightly than OR in the discriminating two-versus-one result. Implicit AND works. Malformed parentheses and unknown keyword return 400 InvalidRequestException; numeric duration compared to a string was accepted and matched no traces.

Native GetTraceGraph rejects two IDs (including duplicates) with Currently only one trace Id is supported despite model/documented maximum five. A single unknown ID returns Trace id not found; no empty successful graph is substituted.

Group filter update is not retroactive graph recomputation: old-version graph data remains and ContainsOldGroupVersions becomes true. group.name filter propagation is asynchronous (initially seven old matching traces, later two fault traces). New v2-only graph eventually has only the new fault sample. Group control/tag absence is verified after deletion while historical graph retrieval by deleted ARN still returned data.

84 request-correlated native CloudTrail records include GetTraceSummaries/GetTraceGraph/GetServiceGraph as readOnly Data events with resources type AWS::XRay::Trace and no invented ARN. Successful query read responseElements are null; request timestamps are ISO UTC strings. Group create/update/delete/get/list and list-tags are Management events. This count includes real failed API calls, not only successes.
